composed: check_hand over each question, entry_unbacked over each option

questions.question: (R379)(4)(d), b769: the two archives of the subject cluster on the Lean archive of November 2026, the workspace bundle and the supplement of 25 November, are handed to the seat at this one prompt, in the way you choose. How are they handed?

options.label: On this host, folder in note
options.description: Both archives stand in one folder on this host, named in your note to this answer. The seat lists each archive's members, checks each member against the archive's own digest list where one is carried, unpacks to scratch for the address scan alone, runs nothing of them and prints no line of a member, then commits both as bytes with one manifest under clusters/lean-archive-november-2026/ of the papers' repository, which stays private. [B1] is entered where each check reads clean, [B2] where one does not.

options.label: Not handed at this act
options.description: Nothing of them is committed. [B2] is entered with its trigger, the archives handed at a later act, and the cluster's REGISTRY row is written in its second form. The act goes on to Components 3 and 4.
